remarks: Rarely available in this sought-after Newbury Park neighborhood, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath single-story home sits on a quiet residential street where inventory is limited. The primary suite offers a private ensuite bath, while two additional bedrooms and a full hall bath provide flexibility for guests, a home office, or hobbies. A well-manicured front lawn creates lasting curb appeal, and the low-maintenance backyard lets you enjoy outdoor time without the upkeep. Convenient to local shopping, dining, parks, and commuter routes, this home combines a great location with easy everyday living.
